ext-tasks-notifications-via-listen.client: n/a:a MAY mcpx does not take: it declares no tasks extension upstream

caching-public-shareable.client: n/a:informational -- permits sharing a public result across users; imposes nothing

mrtr-single-use-enforced.server: n/a:binds only a server whose requestState must be consumed once; mcpx's is re-minted every round and replaying it re-enters the same running call

caching-may-refetch-early-serve-stale.client: n/a:a MAY mcpx does not take -- refresh is synchronous on read (decision on #1601); stale is served only when a refetch of an expired entry fails (#1603)

caching-page-refetch.client: n/a:not applicable by construction -- the pool caches one aggregated catalogue per configured server, never per page; an expired catalogue is re-fetched whole (#1601, #1604)

caching-key-method-params.client: n/a:not applicable by construction -- the pool catalogue cache is keyed by the configured server, not by method+params, and resources/read results are not cached by the pool (#1604)
